description_en: Retrieves a rented join permission (either a dedicated or roaming join permission) for the current user account based on the join permission ID
description_zh: 根据入网凭证ID，获取当前用户账号租用的入网凭证（可能是专用入网凭证或泛在入网凭证）
name: GetRentedJoinPermission

Data.description_en: The information about the rented join permission
Data.description_zh: 租用的入网凭证信息列表

BoundNodeGroupId.description_en: The ID of the node group bound to the join permission

BoundNodeGroupName.description_en: The name of the node group bound to the join permission
BoundNodeGroupName.description_zh: 凭证绑定的节点组名称

ClassMode.description_en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used by the join permission. Valid values: A, B, and C
ClassMode.description_zh: 入网凭证采用的LoRaWAN Class模式，可取值：A、B、C

CreateMillis.description_en: The time when the join permission was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateMillis.description_zh: 入网凭证的创建时间，格式为 UNIX 时间戳，以毫秒为单位

Enabled.description_en: The enabled or disabled status of the join permission. A value of true indicates that the join permission is enabled. A value of false indicates that the join permission is disabled
Enabled.description_zh: 入网凭证的启停用状态。true表示启用，false表示停用

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID of the frequency band used by the join permission
FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_zh: 入网凭证采用的频段的频段ID

JoinEui.description_en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission

JoinPermissionName.description_en: The name of the join permission

NodesCnt.description_en: The number of nodes that use the join permission
NodesCnt.description_zh: 使用该入网凭证的节点数量

RxDailySum.description_en: The number of uplink packets for the join permission on the current day
RxDailySum.description_zh: 入网凭证的当天上行数据包量

RxDelay.description_en: The receive window delay for Class A

RxMonthSum.description_en: The number of uplink packets for the join permission in the current month
RxMonthSum.description_zh: 入网凭证的当月上行数据包量

TxDailySum.description_en: The number of downlink packets for the join permission on the current day
TxDailySum.description_zh: 入网凭证的当天下行数据包量

TxMonthSum.description_en: The number of downlink packets for the join permission in the current month
TxMonthSum.description_zh: 入网凭证的当月下行数据包量

Type.description_en:
The type of the join permission. Valid values:

LOCAL: dedicated join permission.
ROAMING: roaming join permission
Type.description_zh:
入网凭证的类型。取值：

LOCAL：专用凭证。
ROAMING：泛在凭证

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
